changes.summary: Lens adds ReportCompositionEditor over createReportDraft: add from the report picker, drag-handle and keyboard reorder and resize, card captions, widths and local periods, distinct Save draft/Publish and Save changes/Cancel lifecycles, a shared-edit impact dialog with host usage counts, revision-conflict recovery (ReportRevisionConflictError, draft.rebase keep/discard, host copy), createReportLeaveGuard for unload and in-app navigation, and an external proposal preview (report.Proposal) with apply, reject and a stale-base check via reportDraftToken. createReportDraft no longer reports an unchanged draft as dirty when the host writes keys in another order.

Lens report placements render as one embeddable card: a host-gated actions menu (open, edit, configure, independent copy, remove), distinct deleted/forbidden/incompatible/unsupported/error states (Compose degrades placements whose Host.Report returns report.ErrReportDeleted or report.ErrReportForbidden), a card-local retry and calculation time with timezone, and host panel renderers (panel.Renderer, LensDashboard renderers) inside the shared frame.

Lens report picker: Escape in a report preview returns to the list and keeps the selection (only Escape on the list closes the dialog), and report.CatalogScopeShared no longer includes built-in system reports, which now appear only under All.

Lens adds a report picker over a host catalog: report.Library/CatalogQuery/CatalogPage/CatalogEntry (ownership, owner, compound member count, restriction, placements in the target; no totals) with Catalog.Search, MarkPlaced and PlacementCounts, and report.Destinations for adding an opened analysis to a dashboard. @iota-uz/sdk/lens exports ReportPicker (search, owner tabs, paging, preview, already-placed marking with an explicit second card, distinct empty/no-match/error states, Add N with a retry-stable confirmation id), ReportDestinationPicker, appendReportPicks, createReportPickerSelection and LensMessagesProvider. Nested Lens focus traps now yield Tab and Escape to the most recently opened one.

Add Lens report placement version states (report.Resolved.Version, compareReportVersion, ReportPlacementHost): an update offer that keeps opened figures, an incompatible placement composed as an unavailable group instead of failing the dashboard, no printed figures for it, and reportPlacementActions capability gating.
